Write release notes for version 2.5.0: one Markdown bullet per merged pull request, user-facing wording, keep the #number.
#409 Add a per-client timeout override
#412 Retry webhook delivery on 503
#418 Remove the unused legacy CSV export

## Version 2.5.0

* Added the ability to configure custom timeout overrides for individual clients (#409).
* Improved webhook reliability by automatically retrying delivery when receiving a 503 (Service Unavailable) response (#412).
* Removed the legacy CSV export option to streamline export functionality (#418).
